ap.checkpoint_selection: minimum external VAL categorical crossentropy over five epochs
ap.decoding: Sum p0+p4 to Ana and p1+p5 to CHG, retain p2 WHG/p3 EHG, then apply four-way argmax. This may differ from native six-way argmax.
ap.target_semantics: Biological four-founder population at exact simulation census350; native BAA-specific paths receive no positive labels.

argmix.prospective_adapter_supervision: Runtime adapter joins explicit external midpoint labels only; native built-in NPZ/first-SNP resolver is not invoked.

dependencies.ap_runtime: Existing source-qualified CPU prefix from expanded_native_ancestralpaths_v1.py:144 and run_expanded_native_ancestralpaths_v2.py:193-197 (TensorFlow-cpu2.15.1/Keras2.15.0). Runtime not imported/probed in this source task.
dependencies.native_ABI: No compiled library or model is loaded in this review; existing runtime must expose the pinned current-release SampleBatchIterator/next_flat ABI.

native_settings_changes: Explicit four-founder output labels and cohort roles; NF/Yam donor vocabulary is distinct from ancestry output classes.
Per-query identity exclusion removes both focal haplotypes before native Rust nearest-reference selection.
Disable release-template train drop-nearest augmentation; keep nearest 15 allowed donors in both TRAIN/VAL.
Include edge trees and keep native subgraph merging disabled to preserve exact shared target intervals.
Use existing registered fit seeds instead of native hardcoded ARGMix seed50/unset Keras seed.

ARGMix native model/loss/AdamW/chunking/early-stop algorithms retained, with explicit midpoint external labels and unlabeled observed context; wholly unlabeled chunks are omitted from loss iterations.

AP feature eligibility is replaced by the shared donor set and exact sample mapping; age=int(ancestor time)/1500 consistently uses released training behavior, while native paint.py uses floating time.
AP released six-head architecture and five epochs retained; explicit Adam defaults/batch32 and external validation selection are new frozen choices.
AP no-BAA four-founder supervision means heads4/5 (zero-based native BAA paths) receive no positive targets; this is an AncestralPaths-derived C4 adapter, not the unchanged published/native task.
